scope: exploratory single host with two independent A100s, stock 256-row baseline, 4096 KV blocks and 1536 prefix-cache blocks on each GPU
reset: fresh model processes and separate bearer tokens for each policy run
routing_inputs: observed outstanding requests, message-prefix fingerprints, completed prompt length minus 16, byte/4 input estimate; cost in ms = 60 * active + 0.09 * estimated uncached tokens
routing_domain: one trusted benchmark client can reach both replicas for the routing trial; separate credentials and KV address spaces for the two-tenant isolation trial
load: waves of 1, 2, 4, 8 workflows submitted 25ms apart, 100 history entries, 2 versus 96 tool observations, 100ms delay per tool; identical seeds across policies
acceptance: record all submitted, correctness, final first/last p95, streaming gap, SLO goodput and aggregate allocation time; at least two starts before any selection; no production target inferred
